items.title: Arbitrum Pauses New Stylus Activations in Emergency Security Action

items.title: Bank group sues U.S. regulator over granting crypto trust charters
items.summary: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, accusing the regulator of overstepping its legal authority.

items.title: California Subpoenas OpenAI Over AI Models That Hacked Their Way Out of a Test
